# 復古編

**ID:** KR1j0031
**Custom ID:** ZB1j0028

**Source:** 四庫全書 文淵閣版, V225.3, p679
**Extent:** 11 卷
**Base edition:** SBCK

## Authors / Editors
- 張有 (宋朝) 撰 d. 1054

**Editions:** WYG

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A comprehensive Sòng orthographic dictionary by Zhāng Yǒu 張有 (1053–1113), grandson of the Northern-Sòng poet Zhāng Xiān 張先. Following the *Shuōwén jiězì* in defining the *zhèng* (correct) form, with *biétǐ* and *sútǐ* (alternative and vulgar) forms appended in the gloss, on the model of Yán Yuánsūn's [顏元孫](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%A1%8F%E5%85%83%E5%AD%AB) *Gānlù zìshū* [KR1j0023](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1j/KR1j0023). Internally arranged by four-tone rhyme classes, with the *zhèng* graph in seal-script and the *biètǐ* in the gloss. The lower *juàn* concludes with six appended *biànzhèng* essays: (1) *liánmián zì*, (2) *xíngshēng xiānglèi*, (3) *xíngxiānglèi*, (4) *shēngxiānglèi*, (5) *bǐjì xiǎoyì*, (6) *shàng zhèng xià é*.

**Abstract**

The *Fùgǔ biān* is the principal Northern-Sòng work of orthographic standardization for *zhèngtǐ* (correct-form) writing. Zhāng Yǒu — grandson of the famous *cí*-poet Zhāng Xiān, but himself a Daoist priest of Húzhōu — produced the work as a refinement of Yán Yuánsūn's catholic principle (do not impose seal-script on clerical writing) within the methodological framework of the *Shuōwén* radical analysis. The four-tone arrangement and the six appended *biànzhèng* essays (especially the *liánmián zì* essay on binomial expressions) make the *Fùgǔ biān* a key Sòng-period source on word-formation as well as orthography. It is one of the founding works of the *zhèngtǐ* writing tradition that culminates in the early-Qing imperial orthography of the *Kāngxī zìdiǎn* [KR1j0048](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1j/KR1j0048). Note that the catalog meta gives the extent as "11 卷" but the *tíyào* and bibliographic record give "2 *juàn*" (= upper / lower); the apparent discrepancy is a counting convention of the WYG fascicle subdivision. Dating bracket *notBefore* 1100 (Yuánfú; Zhāng Yǒu's mature philological period) to *notAfter* 1113 (his death). The catalog meta gives "d. 1054" — this is wrong: CBDB gives 1053–1113, and modern reference (e.g., Yú Jìquán 余嘉錫) confirms the later date.
